verdict.rationale: Evidence shows official versioned API clients across multiple languages and a dedicated 'algolia-migration' skill for migrating client code to the latest major version, implying a versioning scheme, but there is no documentation of an explicit deprecation policy, timelines, or sunset schedule for older API versions. Missing for 10: a published deprecation/sunset policy, version-support timelines, and changelog/versioning docs for the REST API itself.
